'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Scott Lingrell DS Tatooine''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere)|Premiere-D-tatooine.gif|label=Tatooine}}
* '''Deck name:''' Reid Tech, Inc Scum
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
